### [component] Coverflow Carousel  [id: 23997]
by ruixen.ui
A rack of square covers with the perspective reversed. The centre card sits square to the viewer while the ones beside it swing their outer edges forward, so the rack opens toward you instead of folding away. Drag it and the caption underneath follows.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/ruixen.ui/coverflow-carousel/default/preview.1785769945835-40fdf02e-f950-484c-aa20-a6b0993a08a7.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/ruixen.ui/coverflow-carousel?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 23997 })

### [component] Hero Carousel  [id: 24752]
by crafterui
A full-bleed editorial hero driven by a filmstrip: cards share one top edge, the focused card unfurls to full height while its neighbours stay clipped to half, and the whole background re-grades to the focused photo. Wheel, drag, click and arrow keys.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/crafterui.com/hero-carousel/default/preview.1787059372325-b649cf5c-7b55-4ad3-b0d4-a13e810f53c2.png

### [component] Offer Carousel  [id: 8442]
by ravikatiyar162
Offer Carousel
This component provides a sleek, horizontally scrollable display for showcasing offers or featured items. It includes custom navigation arrows and smooth-scrolling functionality, with cards that animate on hover for an engaging user experience.

### [component] Image Stream Hero  [id: 24377]
by ruixen.ui
Two rails of images ride out of the vanishing point at the centre and sweep to both edges, growing and turning as they approach. Perspective does the sweep and the growth at once, and the loop never stops.

### [component] Spline Scene  [id: 1166]
by serafimcloud
A React component that integrates Spline 3D scenes.

Demo component combines interactive 3D visualization with a spotlight effect and responsive text content.

Features:
	•	Lazy-loaded Spline integration
	•	Responsive layout with flex columns
	•	Gradient text effects
	•	Spotlight background effect
	•	Dark theme optimized
